|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Master Sidious]] (version 1 of 1). The image here is the Players Committee repository image of this original state. This is the current text. *: This version's card image was also printed as a slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025).
